text:
mike: Quick check — I'm rotating NAT config for staging VPC (vpc-stg-3) this afternoon. Need confirmation on allowed outbound IPs for partner webhooks. Current egress ranges in our doc are 34.120.45.0/24 and 34.120.46.0/24. Partner asked to add 34.120.0.0/16 — is /16 acceptable?

tara: don't open a /16 for a partner. That's way too broad and violates least-privilege. Which partner is this?

mike: It's eventbridge-proxy (third-party). They say /16 covers all their edge pools. Could we instead add a /24 for their proxy IPs? Maybe 34.120.47.0/24? Or use a DNS-based allowlist?

chen: We egress staging through nat-stg-1. Firewall rule name is `fw-stg-egress-https` — it currently lists the two /24s. To add another /24 I need a short RFC + security approvals. @security-oncall should ack before I touch infra.

sara: Also a reminder: any client IPs that flow through these webhooks must be redacted in our logs per privacy policy unless there's an approved business case. Example fluentd filter we use: 
```
<filter **>
  @type record_transformer
  <record>
    client_ip "REDACTED"
  </record>
</filter>
```
Or use the `ip_redactor` plugin if you want to keep anonymized prefixes. I filed ticket #7832 for log-redaction verification.

security-oncall: ack — we will not approve /16s for partner egress. Single /24 is OK for staging with RFC and owner signoff. For prod this requires sec review + legal if the partner stores raw IPs. Confirm retention and masking in the RFC.

mike: Got it. I'll open an RFC with partner justification, list of IPs they need, and include the config diff. Plan: add 34.120.47.0/24 to `fw-stg-egress-https` and update terraform. Pinging @chen for the terraform PR review + e2e test.

chen: I can review the PR. Please include: 
- terraform change with exact CIDR
- e2e test that calls the partner webhook from staging and validates response
- rollback plan (remove CIDR + revert infra)
Also add the NAT pool CIDR to infra variables (we keep the ranges in infra/secrets as `staging_nats`).

tara: :thumbsup: sounds good. Once the RFC is up, @security-oncall please mark approval so I can merge the change.

infra-bot: deploy-bot created PR: infra#462 to add 34.120.47.0/24 to staging egress rules. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/462

mike: Thanks — I'll attach the RFC link and include the fluentd redaction check in the PR. Will follow up here when RFC is live.
